गद् गद्, cl. 1. P. गदति, जगाद, गदिष्-
यति, अगादीत् or अगदीत्, गदितुम्, to speak
articulately, speak, say, relate, tell anything to a person
(with two acc.); to enumerate; to name, call; cl.
10. P. गदयति, -यितुम्, to thunder: Caus. गाद-
यति, -यितुम्: Desid. जिगदिषति, to intend or wish
to speak or tell: Intens. जागद्यते, जागत्ति; [cf.
Lith. gadijos, zadas, zodis, giedmi; Pol. gadac;
Hib. gadh.]

गद, अस्, m. speaking, speech; a sentence; N.
of a son of Vasu-deva and younger brother of
Kṛṣṇa; disease, sickness; (अम्), n. poison; [cf.
अ-गद.]
—गद-सिंह, अस्, m., N. of an author.
—गदाख्य (˚द-आख्˚), अम्, n., N. of a plant,
= कुष्ठ.
—गदागद (˚द-अग्˚), औ, m. du. the
two Aśvins, physicians of Svarga.
—गदाग्रज
(˚द-अग्˚), अस्, m. the elder brother of Gada, epithet
of Kṛṣṇa.
—गदाग्रणी (˚द-अग्˚), ईस्, m. the
chief of all diseases, consumption.
—गदाम्बर
(˚द-अम्˚), अस्, m. a cloud.
—गदाराति (˚द-अर्˚),
इस्, m. a drug, a medicament (‘the enemy of
diseases’).
—गदाह्व or गदाह्वय (˚द-आह्˚),
अम्, n. a kind of Costus, Costus Speciosus.

गदा, f. a mace, club, bludgeon; the plant Bignonia
Suaveolens; a particular constellation.
—गदाग्रपाणि
(˚दा-अग्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, having a mace in the right hand.
—गदा-धर, अस्, आ, अम्, bearing a club; (अस्),
m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa [cf. कौमोदकी]; N. of a
physician; N. of the author of the work Viṣaya-
vicāra; N. of the father of Mukunda-priya and uncle
of Rāmānanda &c.
—गदाधर-भट्ट, अस्, m., N.
of an author.
—गदा-पर्वन्, अ, n. title of a book
of the Mahā-bhārata.
—गदा-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, a club-
bearer, one who fights with a mace; an epithet of
Kṛṣṇa.
—गदा-युद्ध, अम्, n. a fight with clubs
or bludgeons.
—गदायुध (˚दा-आय्), अस्, आ, अम्,
armed with a club.
—गदावसान (˚दा-अव्˚), अम्,
n., N. of a place near Mathurā (where the mace
[]
thrown by Jarāsandha rested).
—गदा-हस्त, अस्,
आ, अम्, armed with a mace, mace-handed.

गदयित्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, loquacious, talkative, talking
much or idly; libidinous, desirous, lustful; (उस्), m.
a bow; a N. of Kāma or Kandarpa, the god of love.

गदित, अस्, आ, अम्, spoken, said, related; (अम्),
n. speaking, speech.
—गदित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
having spoken, speaking.

गदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, armed with a club, a mace-
bearer; (ई), m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
—गदि-सिंह,
अस्, m., N. of a grammarian.

गद्गद, अस्, आ, अम्, stammering, stuttering;
(अम्), n. stammering; indistinct or convulsive utter-
ance, as sobbing &c.
—गद्गद-त्व, अम्, n. stam-
mering.
—गद्गद-ध्वनि, इस्, m. low inarticulate
expression of joy or grief.
—गद्गद-पद, अम्, n.
inarticulate speech.
—गद्गद-वाच्, क्, f. inarticulate
or convulsive speech, interrupted by sobbing &c.
—गद्गद-स्वर, अस्, m. indistinct or stammering
utterance; (अस्, आ, अम्), uttering stammering sounds;
(अस्), m. a buffalo; N. of a Bodhi-sattva.
गद्गद्य, nom. P. गद्गद्यति, to stammer.

गाद्गद्य गाद्गद्य, अम्, n. (fr. गद्गद),
stammering.

गद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be spoken or uttered;
(अम्), n. prose, composition not metrical yet framed
in accordance with harmony, elaborate prose com-
position.

गदाय गदाय, nom. A., Ved. गदायते,
यितुम्, to become lazy or idle; [cf. गडि.]

गद्याणक गद्याणक or गद्यानक or ग-
द्यालक, अम्, n. a weight, = 32 Guñjās or berries
of the plant Abrus Precatorius, or = 64 such Guñjās
with physicians.
